The evidence is mostly about timing and crisis management, not anti-electoral behavior.","evidence":[{"title":"Regierungserklärung von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2320314","summary":"Scholz said he would request a confidence vote, welcomed the democratic factions’ agreement on a quick and orderly process, and said the point was for citizens to decide how the country should continue. That is direct evidence of accepting electoral contestation as the mechanism for resolving political authority.","question_ids":["4B.1"]},{"title":"Vertrauensfrage und vorzeitige Neuwahlen","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198","summary":"The Bundestag records Scholz’s formal Article 68 confidence procedure, his loss of confidence, and the constitutional path to early elections. This shows he operated inside Germany’s electoral rules rather than trying to bypass them.","question_ids":["4B.1"]},{"title":"394 Abgeordnete sprechen Bundeskanzler Scholz nicht das Vertrauen aus","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw51-de-vertrauensfrage-1033624","summary":"After losing the confidence vote, Scholz accepted that the way was open for new elections. The official record supports a clean institutional transfer to the electoral arena.","question_ids":["4B.1"]},{"title":"Scholz calls for cool heads to pull Germany out of political crisis","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-11-08","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828","summary":"Reuters reported Scholz urged a calm debate over snap-election timing and denied trying to force through his own agenda by delaying the vote. He also said the timing should still allow a fair and democratic election.","question_ids":["4B.1"]},{"title":"German Chancellor Olaf Scholz loses confidence vote, triggering early elections","publisher":"The Guardian","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/16/german-chancellor-olaf-scholz-loses-confidence-vote-triggering-early-elections","summary":"The Guardian reports Scholz intentionally called a vote he expected to lose in order to trigger elections, which is strong evidence that he accepted electoral replacement as the legitimate route out of the crisis.","question_ids":["4B.1"]},{"title":"Zeitpunkt für die Vertrauensfrage des Kanzlers bleibt umstritten","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"2024-11-08","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw45-de-aktuelle-stunde-neuwahlen-1028664","summary":"Parliament records that CDU/CSU, FDP, AfD, and BSW wanted an immediate confidence vote, while Scholz’s allies backed waiting until January. This is evidence of a timing dispute and mistrust, but it is not evidence that Scholz rejected elections themselves.","question_ids":["4B.1"]},{"title":"Explainer-German coalition collapses: What comes next?","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-11-06","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936","summary":"The coalition collapse shows weakened governing authority and political chaos, which undercuts stability. But it still points to constitutional breakdown inside normal party-parliament competition, not rejection of contestable elections.","question_ids":["4B.1"]}]}
